title: Top sector by average close
statementMd:
Which sector has the highest average closing price across all its price rows? Show sector and average rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `sector`, `avg_close`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT t.sector, ROUND(AVG(p.close), 2) AS avg_close FROM prices p JOIN tickers t ON t.symbol = p.symbol GROUP BY t.sector ORDER BY AVG(p.close) DESC LIMIT 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
